ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, managers, and UBOs against the EMLCU internal blacklist, CBE consolidated targeted-financial-sanctions list, UNSC Consolidated List, OFAC SDN, and EU/UK autonomous sanctions; PEP review for current and former senior public officials, their family members and close associates; refresher screening every six months; Enhanced Due Diligence requires documented source of wealth and source of funds for medium-risk holding SPVs.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Investor Services Center (One-Stop-Shop) and Commercial Registry, General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (gafi.gov.eg); electronic name reservation via the GAFI digital platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory legal names must be in Modern Standard Arabic; a Latin-script transliteration may be added as a dual name but the Arabic name is controlling; the name must include the type indicator 'شركة ذات مسؤولية محدودة' or abbreviation 'ذ.م.م'.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / بنك (Central Bank of Egypt license required)
Securities or Brokerage / أوراق مالية أو وساطة (FRA license required)
Islamic / إسلامي (Sharia supervisory board certification required for financial activity)
National or Arab / الوطنية أو العربية (ministerial approval reserved for state entities)
Holding / قابضة (statutory 25% participation test under Companies Law required)
Armed Forces or Military / القوات المسلحة (Ministry of Defense approval only)
Free Zone / المنطقة الحرة (GAFI Free Zones authority approval required)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A one-time extension of 90 days may be filed at GAFI before expiry. Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal within 10 business days to GAFI's Name Facilitation Committee; if denied, appeal to the GAFI Chairman within 15 business days; final judicial review before the State Council Administrative Court within 60 days of the final administrative decision, attaching the original reservation receipt and correspondence.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible. The registered office must be a physical address in Egypt accepted by the Commercial Registry; a registered-agent or managed serviced-office address is generally accepted for a passive equity holding SPV during the initial compliance period, but a letterbox-only premise without any substantive local presence may trigger registry challenge.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 25% annual probability of unannounced GAFI inspection for a medium-risk passive holding SPV; banks also conduct physical on-site due-diligence visits before account activation, with roughly 60% likelihood during the first six months after account opening.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 2020, as amended, particularly the LLC provisions under Articles 16-24; Executive Regulations issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2796 of 2020; referenced with Law No. 4 of 1994 for environmental matters where applicable.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — Investor Services One-Stop Shop; Commercial Registration Office of the Ministry of Trade and Industry through the GAFI digital portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association (عقد تأسيس الشركة ونظامها الأساسي) together with the GAFI Unified Incorporation Application form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for Egyptian LLCs under Law 159 of 2020; capital quotas are freely determined by the founders. There is no escrow account requirement; cash contributions may be paid into the company bank account after incorporation, and in-kind contributions must be described in the Memorandum of Association and valued by the founders.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The subscribers listed in the Memorandum of Association hereby irrevocably subscribe to all issued capital quotas of the Company, and the initial capital allocation stated in the MOA is adopted. (2) The registered office of the Company is fixed at [address], Cairo Governorate, Egypt, and the Managers are authorized to execute the lease and utility documentation necessary for the office. (3) [Name] and [Name] are appointed as the first Managers, with full authority to open bank accounts, sign tax and regulatory filings, appoint professional advisers, and represent the Company before GAFI, the Commercial Registry, and the Tax Authority. (4) The Managing Manager is authorized to certify true copies, affix the corporate seal, and take all actions to implement this resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI e-Invest Investor Portal — Name Reservation Module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File two or more proposed Arabic and English transliterated company names through the GAFI online portal. Pay the nominal name reservation fee and receive the electronic name reservation certificate, which is valid for 60 days. The reserved name must match the trade name and the intended ISIC 6420 holding-company profile.
required_dossiers: Valid passport or national ID copy of each founding shareholder
Proposed company name in Arabic and English transliteration
Statement of intended scope confirming passive shareholding and dividend holding
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected due to similarity with an existing Commercial Registry entry, file a reconsideration request with GAFI within 30 days and submit an alternative transliteration or a distinctive Arabic suffix; no new application fee is required for the first substitute name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Signature, and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Notary Office / GAFI Legal Drafting Unit at the One-Stop Shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association in Arabic including LLC clauses on scope, ISIC 6420 passive holding purpose, capital quotas, management powers, accounting period, and liquidation. All founders must sign in person before the public notary or an authorized GAFI notarial officer; notarization authenticates signatures and confirms legal capacity.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association in quadruplicate
Founder resolution on quota subscription and first-manager appointment
Valid name reservation certificate
Certified passport copies of corporate or natural founding shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies inconsistent clauses, execute a supplementary founders' resolution amending the MOA and re-notarize the corrected pages; if the entity name remains unchanged, no name-reservation cure is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing and Commercial Registry Extraction
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (Invest Egypt) and the Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized MOA/AOA and all statutory dossiers to the GAFI one-stop shop either physically or through the e-Invest portal. GAFI issues the Certificate of Incorporation and coordinates automatic registration in the Commercial Registry to obtain the commercial register extract (السجل التجاري). The holding company is then assigned a commercial registration number and legal entity identity.
required_dossiers: Notarized MOA and Articles of Association
Valid name reservation certificate
Founder passport copies and corporate existence certificates for any legal entity shareholders
Lease contract or title document for the registered office address
Tax card application form and commercial registration cover note
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a query on incomplete signatures or invalid registered-office documents, cure by submitting supplementary signed pages and an Arabic certified translation of the lease within 14 days; if the application is rejected, an administrative reconsideration may be filed with the GAFI Appeals Committee within 60 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) and National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the unified registration through GAFI's one-stop shop to receive the Tax Card (البطاقة الضريبية). Confirm the entity's classification as a passive holding SPV with no operational VAT obligations. If no employees are hired, only the employer registration channel is noted; if managers receive remuneration, enroll them in the applicable social insurance scheme.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Registry extract
Lease contract for the registered office
Managers' resolution designating tax representatives and bank account signatories
Board/managers resolution confirming no active trading activity under ISIC 6420
Bank account opening certificate if obtained before tax registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ETA tax card is delayed due to address or lease-verification mismatches, resubmit the correct supporting lease and proof of utility address, and request the GAFI service manager to escalate the file; a formal escalation letter with a tracking number is accepted within 5 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Corporate Seal Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Bank of Egypt licensed commercial bank — corporate account units
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open an Egyptian-pound and foreign-currency account in the company name at a licensed bank, deposit any cash subscription if not yet paid, obtain online banking credentials, and complete AML/KYC validation of the SPV's ultimate beneficial owner. Obtain a company seal and organize the statutory books and share-quota ledger for corporate governance use.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Tax Card
Commercial Registry extract and lease contract
Managers' resolution on signatory authority and corporate seal custody
Shareholder passport copies and ultimate beneficial ownership declarations
AML/KYC bank forms and source-of-funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires further beneficial-ownership evidence, provide a notarized organizational chart and certified passport copies of all intermediate and ultimate shareholders; if the account application is paused, submit a resubmission letter through the relationship manager within 10 working days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — the entity is a passive equity-holding SPV under ISIC 6420 and conducts no industrial or manufacturing activity. If a future factory or operational branch is added, the Industrial Development Authority (IDA) would issue the operating industrial license at that time.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — passive holding of subsidiary shares, collection of dividends, and management of equity investments do not require an operating license or manufacturing permit. Only the general Tax Card and Commercial Registry registration are mandatory.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — office-only administrative premises with no industrial installation, no EIA screening, and no registration requirement under Law 4 of 1994 is triggered.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOCs, or process emissions are generated. General office operations must comply with Law 4 of 1994 regarding waste handling and domestic sewage, as supplemented by Executive Regulations and Law 93 of 1962 municipal sewer standards for sanitary waste discharge.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Civil Defense Authority for the registered office; structural load inspection or clearance certificate for the leased office premises if required by the building authority; and workplace clearance for any on-site staff under the Occupational Safety and Health rules of Law 12 of 2003 and the Ministry of Labor implementing decrees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance, Arab Republic of Egypt; electronic services via the ETA Taxpayer Portal and the national e-invoicing platform at einvoicing.eta.gov.eg; customs clearance through the NAFEZA single window at nafeza.gov.eg.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the LLC through the GAFI One-Stop Shop and complete Egyptian Commercial Registry filing. Step 2: Open a corporate bank account and , where required, deposit the paid-up capital (no statutory minimum for LLCs). Step 3: Submit the articles of incorporation, board resolutions, and power of attorney to the competent ETA tax office to open a tax file and obtain the unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) and tax card for income tax purposes. Step 4: Upon reaching the VAT registration threshold, apply for VAT registration through the ETA electronic portal; foreign entities without an Egyptian permanent establishment may obtain a VAT ID by lodging certified constitutional documents, foreign tax registration certificates, and a notarized power of attorney. Step 5: Register with the NAFEZA customs system and activate the ETA e-invoicing API profile in preparation for any export or cross-border transaction flows.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt does not provide US-style check-the-box or elective hybrid classification regimes. An Egyptian-resident holding LLC may elect to file a consolidated income tax return with resident subsidiaries in which it holds, directly or indirectly, at least 95% of the subscribed capital, provided all other statutory conditions of Law No. 91 of 2005 are met. No VAT grouping election is available. Hybrid mismatch elections are not permitted; domestic GAAR, thin capitalization, and controlled-foreign-company rules apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable supplies (mandatory); EGP 250,000 voluntary registration threshold; importers are registrable to obtain a VAT ID regardless of turnover
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Phase-based national e-invoicing and e-receipt mandate: VAT-registered taxpayers must generate B2B/B2C invoices using ETA-approved systems with unique cryptographic signature and QR code, submit JSON invoices through the ETA API for real-time validation and clearance before delivery, and retain batch acknowledgement codes. API integration requires OAuth2 credentials and production digital certificates; failure to integrate or disputed rejected invoices trigger ETA dashboard escalations and administrative penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A registered supplier may apply the zero rate to tangible goods exported outside Egypt where physical export is completed and evidenced by customs documentation; services supplied to a non-resident client for use wholly outside Egypt, including offshore equity-holding management and pure intermediary services, may be zero-rated if a direct contract, ETA-compliant invoice, and non-resident status evidence are maintained. Input VAT recovery is conditional on strict substantive and documentary proof of the export transaction, including timely receipt of export consideration in Egypt.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Certified Customs Export Declaration (NAFEZA Bayed export statement)
Bill of Lading or House Air Waybill evidencing shipment from Egyptian territory
Commercial invoice and foreign-currency sales contract
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT receipt evidencing transfer of export proceeds
ETA-approved packing list, freight documents, and multimodal transport evidence
Certificate of foreign buyer tax status or residence certification for offshore services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA audit units apply enhanced scrutiny to recurring export zero-rating and refund claims, requiring full reconciliation among customs declarations, container movements, invoicing, and FX inflows. For fraudulent or falsely documented zero-rating claims, Law No. 67 of 2016 imposes tax evasion penalties of imprisonment from six months to five years together with fines of EGP 200,000 to EGP 2,000,000, plus mandatory repayment of the refunded input VAT with a 2% monthly late-payment surcharge. The Customs Authority may also suspend the exporter's NAFEZA clearance authorization until clawback amounts are fully settled.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) and the Egyptian Exchange (EGX) are the principal sovereign regulators; the CBE exclusively administers foreign exchange licensing, exchange-rate policy, and banking supervision under the Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020, the Foreign Exchange Law No. 80 of 2002 (as amended), and the Anti-Money Laundering/Combating Financing of Terrorism Law No. 80 of 2002.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Egyptian Pound (EGP) is partially convertible. Current account transactions, including trade settlement and regular dividend remittance, are materially free and clear with no mandatory pre-approval, subject to source-document evidence and tax clearance. Capital account transactions, including equity injection, capital repatriation, and liquidation proceeds, are governed by the CBE's foreign investment registration rules and the General Authority for Investment (GAFI) requirements. Profit repatriation requires audited financial statements, corporate tax certificates, and confirmation of repatriation entitlement under the investment approval. The CBE and Ministry of Finance retain legal authority to impose temporary convertibility restrictions or capital-flow management measures during acute balance-of-payments stress; current conditions are stable, but compliance planning must anticipate potential future surrender regimes.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: As of the current CBE liberalization period, there is no mandatory percentage surrender of export proceeds. Export receipts must be received through Egypt's regulated banking channel, either via telegraphic transfer, documentary collection, or letter of credit, and the exporter is required to deposit the foreign currency into a CBE-designated foreign currency account with a licensed domestic bank within 90 days from the date of export aboard or within the commercial credit term agreed (maximum 120 days for the tangible export). The exporter may retain the proceeds in foreign currency or voluntarily convert into EGP. In the event of renewed exchange crisis, CBE retains the statutory power, under Law No. 80 of 2002, to reintroduce a mandatory surrender ratio (historically up to 50-75%) for all export proceeds. The pure equity holding SPV is not a goods exporter and therefore has no surrender obligation, but dividend remittance is classified as current account consideration and is subject to documentary verification.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Dividends Collection Account / Operational Account / Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account / Dividends Collection Account / Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account / Capital Escrow Account / Dividends Collection Account
Cross-Border Clearing Account / Operational Account / Capital Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital financial institutions and EMI-licensed banks located outside Egypt are not viable for primary domestic treasury operations. The CBE does not permit offshore fintech/EMI entities to hold EGP clearing accounts, to issue EGP-denominated instruments, or to act as an Egyptian settlement member for investor capital inflows or dividend repatriation. An offshore EMI may be used solely as a low-value FX-prefunding channel if the ultimate clearing and settlement are executed through a CBE-regulated correspondent bank; however, for an equity holding SPV, the compliance risk, funding ambiguity, and CBE source-of-funds scrutiny render this channel low feasibility and legally weak. The mandated backbone is a direct tier-1 relationship with a licensed domestic Egyptian commercial bank or a local branch of a banking group incorporated as an Egyptian joint-stock company.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: CBE Anti-Money Laundering rules impose a mandatory face-to-face interview and physical verification of the beneficial owner, senior managers, and signatories for all corporate clients classified as Medium_Risk_Enhanced. Remote onboarding is generally not permitted for a cross-border holding SPV with no historical track record in Egypt. The directors, ultimate beneficial owners, and authorized bank signatories must attend an in-person interview at the bank's headquarters, or at an Egyptian embassy in the case of offshore directors only if the bank agrees to a notarized power-of-attorney and passport verification; in practice, the CBE treats unverified remote opening as a critical AML deficiency. The onboarding committee also requires the corporate records, statutory registers, and beneficial-ownership declarations to be apostilled or consular-legalized for the Egyptian jurisdiction, and a certified Arabic translation will be required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) is a non-resident individual residing in a high-risk jurisdiction or maintains opaque structure through the equity chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full corporate chart from ultimate beneficial owner to the Egyptian SPV; certified passport and proof of address; legalized constitutional documents for each holding company; a written UBO declaration setting out control chain percentages and no-risk indicators; a sworn statement of source of wealth and source of draft capital, supported by six months of bank statements from the contributor's primary banking relationship; independent professional reference from an international law firm or an auditor registered in a FATF-compliant jurisdiction; commitment letter to maintain a fully transparent relationship with CBE.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Purpose of the Egyptian SPV is passive dividend holding, which may be classified as money laundering or tax-evasion risk and as an artificial conduit
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Strategic investment memorandum and board resolution approving the Egyptian equity holding structure; audited financial statements of the ultimate parent; valid GAFI investment registration or Egyptian commercial registry certificate indicating ISIC 6420; detailed flow-of-funds map showing the original capital injection from an identifiable corporate treasury as opposed to third-party unverified entities; the Egyptian SPV's tax compliance history or a tax-clearance certificate; external legal opinion confirming the SPV's commercial substance, including an Egypt-based registered office and resident officer presence; evidence that the SPV exercises genuine ownership functions, such as subsidiary governance, dividend policy, and capital structure decisions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial inbound capital contribution exceeding a threshold triggers enhanced due diligence under the Egyptian AML law (statutory threshold of EGP 600,000 or its equivalent in foreign currency)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Banking counterpart and route documentation for the inward wire, including SWIFT MT103/MT202; source of funds documentation signed by the direct shareholder; board minutes approving the capital injection; the notarized certificate of legal existence of the parent entity; confirmed tax reference numbers of both remitter and receiver; identification of all intermediaries and correspondent banks in the payment chain; the investment licence and the foreign investment registration certificate received from GAFI; and a signed declaration that no funds are derived from criminal or sanctionable sources.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Directors or shareholders domiciled in a sanctions-affected or politically exposed person (PEP) jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening results from each bank's CBE-compliant screening system; independent PEP status certification; a certified copy of the passports or national identity documents; for commercial entities, proof of no ownership by Norwegian/dual-use controlled persons or sanctioned designees; provision of an external compliance opinion, prepared under Egyptian law, confirming that the SPV is not subject to any active freeze order, asset-preservation measure, or watchlist designation by the CBE or the Egyptian Ministry of Justice.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital investments must be routed via the Egyptian banking sector under CBE registration and matching with the investment licence from GAFI. The designated purpose code must clearly state 'Inward Direct Investment — Equity Participation' and align with the CBE external transactions classification (Category 1118 — Direct Investment Equity Capital). The sponsor's bank must receive (i) the GAFI certificate, (ii) the Egyptian commercial registry extract showing the LLC, (iii) the SPV's board resolution approving issuance of registered shares or increase of equity, (iv) the parent company's constitutional documents, and (v) a wire-transfer instruction referencing the Egyptian entity identification number and the legal entity identifier code; the bank will verify the incoming funds within 10 business days and issue a CBE inward FX registration certificate, necessary for future repatriation. The clearing rail must always be an authenticated SWIFT MT103 for the actual injection and perhaps an MT202 for the cover payment if correspondent banks require a separate cover.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The SPV is a passive holding entity, but any outbound trade-related disbursements, such as payments for professional services, shareholder loans, dividends, or intercompany financings, must be executed under the applicable CBE purpose code. Dividend repatriation uses the 'Dividends and Profit Distribution' purpose code and requires an MT103 to the ultimate parent's account, together with an Egyptian tax withholding certificate, audited financial statements, tax returns for the fiscal year, subsidiary distribution resolutions, and a bank-verified confirmation that all mandatory CBE foreign-asset registration procedures have been completed. For intra-group loan servicing, an MT103 plus MT199 with the full loan agreement, interest computation schedule, and CBE external debt registration is used. The clearing rail may be enhanced with a commercial letter of credit, SWIFT MT700, for any operational trade covered by the SPV's subsidiary chain; however, for the pure equity holding structure, the MT103/MT202 interbank wire network and the Egyptian real-time gross settlement system (EG-RTGS) are the sole practical rails.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore EGP/foreign exchange delivered forwards between CBE-licensed banks and the SPV, based on actual current and swiftly upcoming FX exposures arising from dividend receipts or repatriation obligations, with a maximum maturity of 12 months and no collateralisation requirement for the SPV beyond standard ISDA-style credit-support annex or bank guarantee.

Non-deliverable offshore EGP forwards transacted with a reputable international bank through an Egyptian licensed bank's offshore branch, provided that the notional exposure is limited to eligible EGP-denominated dividend and capital flows and that the transaction never results in physical delivery within Egypt unlicensed by the CBE.

Currency swaps executed with a CBE-licensed bank for simultaneous exchange of EGP and USD principal flows in relation to the SPV's shareholder loans or refinancing, subject to the bank's internal treasury approval and an express confirmation of the commercial purpose below the super-receivable threshold.

Currency options and plain-vanilla EGP/USD options, both bought and written, when used strictly as a cashflow hedge against adverse EGP depreciation on the SPV's expected dividend income; any premium financing or speculative options strategy is prohibited.
FX swaps under the CBE's interbank FX swap rules, to cover temporary EGP liquidity gaps without altering the SPV's trade-instrument risk profile.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (Form No. 1) for juridical persons, attaching audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the tax year; standard Egypt tax year ends 30 June (return due 31 October); calendar-year books, when approved by ETA, use 31 December year end (return due 30 April)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed fine EGP 2,000-10,000 under Article 139, Law No. 91/2005; 2% monthly late-payment surcharge under Article 110; enforced joint assessment, bank attachment, and criminal liability for deliberate evasion

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements and auditor's report submitted to the Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months of the fiscal year end; 45-day extension permissible; calendar-year filers: by 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: GAFI warning followed by administrative strike-off from the Commercial Registry after two consecutive years of non-filing under Companies Law No. 4/2022

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registration renewal (quintennial re-registration of the LLC with the Commercial Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry, Ministry of Trade and Industry (filed via GAFI one-stop shop)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Every 5 years from the last registration date; renewal application filed within the 30 calendar days preceding expiry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal penalties under Commercial Registration Law No. 34/1976; cancellation of the registration for prolonged non-renewal, depriving the SPV of legal capacity to operate, contract, or open bank accounts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership (UBO) annual confirmation and statutory register update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI Companies Registry - Beneficial Owner Register (Egyptian AML/FIU framework)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual re-confirmation due within 3 months of fiscal year end; any change in shareholding or ultimate ownership reported to GAFI within 30 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to EGP 100,000 under Companies Law No. 4/2022 and AML Law No. 8/2002; suspension of the beneficial owner's voting and dividend rights until the register is corrected

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No size or revenue exemption: every Egyptian LLC must appoint at least one independent auditor licensed by the ETA under Companies Law No. 4/2022; the auditor's report must accompany both the annual CIT return and the GAFI financial statement filing; a pure-equity holding SPV is in scope even with nil operating revenue, and consolidated audited statements are required when the SPV heads a group
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), issued by the Ministry of Investment and the Financial Regulatory Authority and substantively aligned with IFRS; binding for all LLC financial statements for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2015; dividend and equity-method recognition under EAS applies to the holding SPV

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SPV must maintain a statutory Register of Beneficial Owners and re-confirm it annually with GAFI together with the annual financial statements (within 3 months of fiscal year end); every transfer of shares or change in ultimate beneficial ownership must be filed with GAFI within 30 days; the annual confirmation is a condition for GAFI's ongoing certificate of compliance required by Egyptian banks
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholders) with ownership percentages and transfer history
Minute Book of shareholder resolutions and management decisions
Register of Beneficial Owners (required by Law No. 4/2022)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400-1,200 per year (Cairo registered office, GAFI/ETA representative agent, and courier handling)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 900-2,500 for a non-trading holding SPV; Big-4 firms from approximately USD 3,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday is available for a standard Egyptian LLC operating as a pure equity holding SPV. The only material preference is the exclusion of Egyptian intercompany dividends from taxable income when the distributing Egyptian subsidiary's profits have already been fully subject to Egyptian CIT. Foreign-source dividends may benefit from DTA relief only upon substantiation of beneficial ownership. No reduced rate, investment zone, or export incentive applies to passive ISIC 6420 holding activities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Model No. 11 (Corporate Income Tax Return for Juridical Persons) filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority E-Tax Portal (eta.gov.eg).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year EG_LLC, the filing deadline is 30 April.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: legal name, Egyptian tax card number, commercial registration number, and registered address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Egyptian LLC's tax card and commercial registration data only; non-resident beneficial owners are not listed on the corporate return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year-end date and accounting basis.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use 31 December unless a different fiscal year has been approved by the ETA; maintain books under Egyptian GAAP or IFRS as used for tax filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income and revenue, including dividends, interest, gains on share disposals, and other investment income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all Egyptian-source passive income realized by the SPV even if the income is subsequently repatriated or treaty-protected under a DTA.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible expenses: operating costs, depreciation, financing costs, audit fees, and local administrative overheads.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Keep deductions strictly substantiated; intercompany management fees and shareholder interest must satisfy the Egyptian arm's length rules and transfer pricing documentation obligations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after statutory deductions and tax loss carryforward of up to 5 years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach schedules supporting the loss carryforward computation; losses of a pure holding SPV may be scrutinized for artificial allocation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax computed at 22.5% on taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No branch remittance tax applies to an Egyptian LLC; the 22.5% tax is the final entity-level burden before any dividend withholding on distribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly advance CIT payments made during the year and final balance payable or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident parent cannot net its own tax attributes against the Egyptian SPV's final balance; any refund is paid to the SPV bank account.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing exposes the company to a statutory fine of up to EGP 50,000 under Law 91/2005, plus a delay surcharge of 2% per month on the unpaid tax. Fraudulent returns attract criminal tax evasion penalties, imprisonment, and mandatory tax collection.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Withholding Tax Return (Model 41) and quarterly advance CIT settlement statement, both delivered through the ETA E-Tax Portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Withholding tax on dividends, interest, and royalties must be remitted within 15 days after the end of the month in which payment is made; quarterly advance CIT installments fall due within 15 days after each quarter-end, with final settlement accompanying Model 11.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-resident recipient identification: name, country of tax residence, tax identification number, and bank account details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the home jurisdiction Tax Residency Certificate and beneficial ownership declaration before any treaty rate is claimed; otherwise the full statutory rate must be withheld.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross amounts paid and withholding tax computed at statutory rates: 10% on dividends, 20% on interest, and 20% on royalties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute WHT on the gross Egyptian-source amount actually remitted to the non-resident parent without deduction of internal fees or treaty abstractions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Treaty rate claimed and supporting DTA article reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the applicable DTA article and attach the ETA international taxation approval letter obtained in advance; the SPV remains liable for any under-withholding if relief is rejected.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-remittance or under-withholding generates a monthly delay surcharge of 2% on the amount not paid, disallowance of the related expense, administrative fines of up to EGP 50,000, and criminal exposure for directors where the SPV is used to structure abusive dividend stripping.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A non-resident shareholder must file a treaty relief application with the ETA International Taxation Department before the dividend payment date, attaching: (i) an original or certified Tax Residency Certificate issued by the residence state tax authority; (ii) a certificate of the ownership chain evidencing shareholding percentage and holding period; (iii) a beneficial ownership declaration confirming that the non-resident is the ultimate economic recipient and has no obligation to pass the dividends on; and (iv) board resolutions authorizing the distribution. Upon approval, the payer applies the reduced treaty dividend rate, commonly 5% where the parent holds at least 25% of the Egyptian SPV's capital and up to 10% in portfolio shareholding contexts. If no prior approval is obtained, the payer must withhold at the statutory 10% and the non-resident may reclaim the differential through an administrative objection and, ultimately, the DTA Mutual Agreement Procedure.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates are 20% for interest and 20% for royalties and technical fees. Under Egypt's double tax agreements, interest is frequently reduced to 10-15% and royalties to 5-10%, subject to identical TRC and beneficial ownership substantiation. An Egyptian holding SPV financing a subsidiary must document arm's length interest rates and cannot rely on treaty reduction where the lender is a conduit without economic substance.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 1,000,000 aggregate annual related-party transactions, being the ETA threshold that triggers mandatory contemporaneous Local File preparation; Master File obligations apply to multinational groups exceeding the ETA-published consolidated revenue ceiling or upon formal ETA request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt has no formalised Economic Substance Regulations regime equivalent to the UAE. However, the Egyptian Tax Authority applies a rigorous substance-over-form and general anti-avoidance doctrine, including beneficial ownership tests under the DTA articles and domestic GAAR principles. A pure equity holding SPV must maintain an Egyptian registered office, local management decisions, board minutes, separate bank accounts, and contemporary accounting records; a shell arrangement lacking these elements may be disregarded and its dividend income reattributed to the ultimate parent.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Falsification of the Annual CIT Return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally understating taxable income in Model 11, concealing dividend or interest income, destroying ledgers, or submitting forged invoices and shareholding documents to the Egyptian Tax Authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law 91/2005, deliberate evasion carries imprisonment of not less than 3 years and a fine of EGP 100,000 to EGP 1,000,000, together with collection of the evaded tax plus a 2% monthly delay surcharge.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Managing directors and signatories are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax; the court may freeze personal assets, impose travel bans, seize passports, and prevent the directors from leaving Egypt pending resolution of the criminal case.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Sham Interposition and Shell Company Substance Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the EG_LLC exclusively as a conduit to route Egyptian subsidiary dividends to a low-tax or zero-tax foreign parent without any Egyptian office, personnel, business rationale, board deliberation, or local bank account.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The ETA disregards the intermediary, attributes the dividend income to the ultimate shareholder, denies treaty benefits, reimposes 22.5% CIT on deemed profit and 10% final dividend withholding, and levies late surcharges and penalties of up to EGP 1,000,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced against incorporators and nominees; directors face civil restitution for unpaid taxes, administrative disqualification, and criminal aiding-and-abetting sanctions for facilitating treaty abuse.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging non-arm's length intercompany interest, excessive management fees, or artificially priced share subscription and loan instruments without preparing the mandatory Local File and Master File, or failing to file when related-party transactions exceed EGP 1,000,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The ETA adjusts the transaction to the arm's length result, disallows the excess deduction, imposes the 2% monthly delay surcharge on the adjusted tax, and applies documentation-specific penalties; repeated violations escalate to criminal false-statement liability.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve or sign false transfer pricing documentation are co-debtors for the additional tax; serious concealment triggers personal criminal prosecution and travel restrictions during the ETA investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering and Beneficial Ownership Concealment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using nominee shareholders, undisclosed trust arrangements, or opaque SWIFT wire flows through the Egyptian holding SPV to conceal criminal proceeds or evade Egyptian financial intelligence reporting obligations under AML Law No. 80/2002.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money laundering offences are punishable by imprisonment and fines of up to the value of the laundered funds, mandatory asset forfeiture, blacklisting by the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit, suspension of the company's tax card, and freezing of all corporate bank accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Senior managers and beneficial owners are personally prosecuted, subjected to national and international travel bans, asset freezes, and extradition exposure; directors cannot rely on the corporate veil to shield themselves from criminal restitution and imprisonment.
